data.name: Backrooms: The Wrong Door
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms: The Wrong Door is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. A single wrong door leads you into a shifting nightmare where reality feels broken, familiar places become hostile, and every step forward may bring you closer to something watching from the dark.

Play alone or with friends as you explore abandoned corridors, survive unpredictable encounters, and uncover the truth behind a place that was never meant to be found.

‘It’ mercilessly punishes those who walk through the wrong door

Features

  • Dark and oppressive atmosphere

  • Online Co-op

  • Proximity voice communication

  • Reactive and immersive enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty options

  • Stealth-oriented survival gameplay

  • Large interconnected environments filled with danger

  • Minimalistic yet punishing mechanics

  • Dynamic visibility system affected by movement, posture, shadows, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is not a strict adaptation of existing Backrooms lore. Instead, it delivers an original interpretation inspired by the concept, combining psychological horror, environmental storytelling, and unique gameplay systems to create a more unpredictable experience.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud noises, and intense audiovisual effects that may affect sensitive players.
